en.title: Crispy Neapolitan-Style Potato Cake
en.description: A clever and quick take on the traditional potato gâteau. This savory cake features a golden, breaded exterior that shatters to reveal a fluffy, melt-in-your-mouth potato and cheese center.

en.title: Zesty Air-Toasted Edamame
en.description: The perfect healthy snack in minutes. Frozen edamame pods are air-toasted until they achieve a satisfyingly roasted texture, then tossed in a bold, spicy seasoning for a kick of flavor.

en.title: Smoky Paprika Roasted Chickpeas
en.description: Swap the store-bought chips for this protein-packed crunch. Legumes are roasted at high heat until crisp and smoky, making them a perfect stand-alone snack or a crunchy garnish for creamy soups.

en.title: Crispy Zucchini Parmesan Crisps
en.description: Light, salty, and totally addictive. Thinly sliced zucchini is coated in sharp Parmesan that crystallizes during cooking, creating a delicate, golden chip that’s big on crunch and low on carbs.
